newsitem.title: USA: Kansas City Power buys stake in telecomm company.
newsitem.headline: Kansas City Power buys stake in telecomm company.

text.p: Kansas City Power and Light Co, through its subsidiary KLT Telecom Inc, said Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to purchase an ownership interest in Digital Teleport Inc, a St. Louis, Mo.-based telecommunications company.
Kansas City Power said the transaction is part of the utility's strategy to pursue growth opportunities in unregulated businesses.

Digital Teleport is building a fiber optic telecommunications network throughout the state of Missouri and adjoining states, including the Kansas City metropolitan area. It currently provides local and interexchange network service to many Missouri cities. The Kansas City network will be interconnected with Digital Teleport's larger system and will be able to access all local and long distance telephone providers.
Primary users of the Kansas City system will be major long distance and local exchange carriers coupled with individual business and residential customers.
"Our ownership position in Digital Teleport gives us a strong foothold in the growing market for fiber optic communications," said Ronald Wasson, president of KLT Telecom, in a statement.

Kansas City Power provides electric power to metropolitan Kansas City and parts of eastern Kansas and western Missouri. KLT Telecom seeks market opportunities in telecommunications infrastructure and wireless communications.
